title: Clock Building, Not Time Telling
coreMove: Turn a brilliant answer into a reusable mechanism that keeps working when the gifted person leaves the room.
sourcePressure: The source rejects dependence on charismatic leaders, isolated brilliant ideas, one great program, or one gifted leader; Collins official support contrasts time-telling with clock-building and program-centered thinking with institution-centered thinking.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing clock building to delegation or process documentation, while leaving the institution dependent on one person for judgment.

sourceAnchors.name: clock building
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar supports clock building as building an organization that keeps ticking over time rather than depending on one great program or one gifted leader
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The clock is the system that keeps answering after the expert has gone home.

hook: the genius consultant finally shares the answer
one brilliant idea saves the company
counterintuition: leadership is not about being smart
tryThisNow: document your process in five minutes
examples: whiteboard framework with no handoff test

exampleSpecs.domain: restaurant allergy station converting the head chef's memory into a shift-proof service system
exampleSpecs.audience: Grace, a sous-chef taking over a busy Saturday service
exampleSpecs.stakes: one nut allergy mistake could send a guest to hospital
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Grace replaces the head chef's verbal reminders with colored ticket clips, a prep-bin layout, and a second-person handoff check that a new line cook can run without her
exampleSpecs.firstImage: almond flour dust on a stainless prep table beside red allergy clips
mustAvoid: chef just gives a better speech

exampleSpecs.domain: community legal clinic turning one senior lawyer's intake instincts into a triage clock
exampleSpecs.audience: Thomas, clinic director facing a Monday queue
exampleSpecs.stakes: tenants could miss filing deadlines if only the senior lawyer can spot urgency
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 8:10 a.m., Thomas tests whether volunteers can route three sample files correctly using the new triage card before the senior lawyer arrives
exampleSpecs.firstImage: three eviction notices clipped to a blue triage card

exampleSpecs.domain: university lab replacing a star technician's freezer map with a barcoded sample system
exampleSpecs.audience: Anke, a lab manager after a near-loss of samples
exampleSpecs.stakes: five years of tissue samples can vanish if only one technician knows the freezer logic
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anke locks the freezer for one hour and asks two graduate students to retrieve blind samples from the barcode map, exposing what the old memory system hid
exampleSpecs.firstImage: frost fog rolling out of a minus-eighty freezer
mustAvoid: star technician praised for remembering everything

exampleSpecs.domain: youth orchestra making auditions fair without the retiring conductor's ear
exampleSpecs.stakes: families will lose trust if selection changes with the conductor
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: David predicts the retiring conductor's ranking, then watches a blind rubric produce nearly the same list without naming the students
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Can the orchestra choose well with the conductor behind a closed door?

exampleSpecs.domain: warehouse returns desk replacing one clerk's knack with a defect-category wall
exampleSpecs.audience: Hanna, operations supervisor covering vacation week
exampleSpecs.stakes: returns pile up and suppliers get wrong chargebacks when the expert clerk is out
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Hanna one vacation week to build a defect wall where any temp could sort returns into supplier action bins by visible cues
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a rolling cart of torn packages parked under fluorescent lights
mustAvoid: the expert clerk trains everyone by storytelling

exampleSpecs.domain: museum membership desk converting a rainmaker's donor calls into a renewal cadence
exampleSpecs.audience: Julien, development manager after the rainmaker announces retirement
exampleSpecs.stakes: a donor base could collapse when relationships are only in one person's phone
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Who calls them after the private tour?" Julien asks, then builds a renewal calendar with triggers, scripts, and ownership that three coordinators can use
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a donor phone list printed from one private contact file
mustAvoid: charismatic fundraiser makes one more round of calls

skillTargets: distinguish a reusable mechanism from a one-off expert answer
choose handoff tests that reveal dependence
spot program-centered thinking disguised as impact

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one task where people still wait for your answer. Write the handoff test: who can perform it tomorrow, using what artifact, while you stay silent.
sourceAnchorsNote: Frozen source sidecars for this book expose concept support and source artifacts, but little chapter-level anecdote detail after chapter 1. Use only the anchors listed here; do not invent company histories, named executives, studies, or dates.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
